Bank Math Master.question: ১) A group of men decided to do a job in 5 days. But since 10 men dropped out every day, the job completed at the end of the 7th day. How many men were there at the beginning?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A group of men decided to do a job in 5 days. But since 10 men dropped out every day, the job completed at the end of the 7th day. How many men were there at the beginning?

Solution: 
Let X be the initial number of men then,
According to the question,
5X = X + (X - 10) + (X - 20) + (X - 30) + (X - 40) + (X - 50) + (X - 60)
or, 5X = 7X - 210
or, 2X = 210
or, X = 210/2
or, X = 105

Bank Math Master.question: ২) Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 20 and 30 hours respectively. If both the pipes are used together, then how long will it take to fill the tank?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 20 and 30 hours respectively. If both the pipes are used together, then how long will it take to fill the tank?

Solution: 
Part filled by A in 1 hour = 1/20

Part filled by B in 1 hour = 1/30

Part filled by (A + B) in 1 hour
= 1/20 + 1/30 = 5/60 = 1/12

∴ Both pipes can fill the tank in 12 hours

Bank Math Master.question: ৩) While working 7 hour a day, A alone can complete a piece of work in 6 days and B alone in 8 days. In what time would they complete it together, 8 hour a day?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: While working 7 hour a day, A alone can complete a piece of work in 6 days and B alone in 8 days. In what time would they complete it together, 8 hour a day?

Solution: 
A can complete the work in 7 × 6 = 42 hours
1 hour's work of A = 1/42

B can complete the work in 7 × 8 = 56 hours
1 hour's work of B = 1/56

(A + B)'s 1 hour's work
=1/42+1/56=4+3/168=7/168

∴ Time taken by (A + B) working 8 hours daily
168/7 = 24 hour

∴ as  the will work 8 hour a day, it will take = 24/8 = 3 days

Bank Math Master.question: ৪) One pipe can fill a tank three times as fast as another pipe. If together the two pipes can fill the tank in 48 minutes, then the slower pipe alone will be able to fill the tank in:
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: One pipe can fill a tank three times as fast as another pipe. If together the two pipes can fill the tank in 48 minutes, then the slower pipe alone will be able to fill the tank in:

Solution: 
Let the faster pipe can fill it in X minutes
in one minute it can fill up = 1/X of the tank 

so the slower pipe can do it in 3X minutes
in one minute it can fill up = 1/3X of the tank

so in one minute both can fill = (1/X + 1/3X)
= 4/3X
the full tank will be filled in = 3X/4 minutes

ATQ,
3X/4 = 48
X = 64

so the slower pipe can do it in = 3 × 64 = 192 minutes

Bank Math Master.question: ৫) A man and a boy received 6000 Tk. as wages for 5 days for the work they did together. The man's efficiency in the work was double that of the boy. What are the daily wages of the boy?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question:  A man and a boy received 6000 Tk. as wages for 5 days for the work they did together. The man's efficiency in the work was double that of the boy. What are the daily wages of the boy?

Solution: 
Ratio of 1 day's work of man and boy = 2 : 1
Total wages of the boy = (6000 × 1/3)
= 2000 Tk.

∴ Daily wages of the boy= 2000/5 = 400Tk.

Bank Math Master.question: ৬) A pipe can fill a cistern in 6 hour. After adding another pipe the whole process took only 4 hour. The second pipe alone can do it in-
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A pipe can fill a cistern in 6 hour. After adding another pipe the whole process took only 4 hour. The second pipe alone can do it in- 

Solution: 
Let the socond pipe can do the work in X hours
so in one hour it can fill = 1/X of the cistern

the first pipe can do in one hour = 1/6 of the cistern

ATQ,
1/X + 1/6 = 1/4
(6 + X)/6X = 1/4
6X = 24 + 4X
x = 12
∴ the second pipe can fill the cistern in 12 hours.

Bank Math Master.question: ৭) 20 men can do a piece of work in 18 days. They worked together for 3 days, then 5 men joined. In how many days is the remaining work completed ?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: 20 men can do a piece of work in 18 days. They worked together for 3 days, then 5 men joined. In how many days is the remaining work completed ?

Solution: 
18 days for the full work
∴ 3 day for = 3/18 = 1/6 of the work

remaining work is = (1 - 1/6) = 5/6

20 men can do 1 work in 18 days
∴ 20 men can do 5/6 work in = (18 × 5/6) = 15 days
∴ 25 men can do 5/6 work in = (15 × 20)/25 days
= 12 days

Alternate: 20 men can do 18 days
So, total work = 18 × 20 = 360
20 men 3 days work = 20 × 3 = 60
Remaining work = 360 - 60 = 300
After joining 5 men total men = 20 + 5 = 25
So, finish the remaining work in =300/25=12 days

Bank Math Master.question: ৯) P is thrice as good a workman as Q and therefore able to finish a job in 48 days less than Q. Working together, they can do it in?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: P is thrice as good a workman as Q and therefore able to finish a job in 48 days less than Q. Working together, they can do it in?

Solution:
Let time taken by P = x days
Then, time taken by Q = 3x days
∴ 3x - x = 48
⇒ 2x = 48
⇒ x = 24
∴ (P + Q)'s 1 day's work
= 1/24+1/72
= (3+1)/72
= 1/18

∴ Required time = 18 days

Bank Math Master.question: ১০) Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 6 and 9  hours respectively. Pipe C can empty it in 12 hours. If all the three pipes are opened together, then the tank will be filled in:
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 6 and 9  hours respectively. Pipe C can empty it in 12 hours. If all the three pipes are opened together, then the tank will be filled in:

Solution: 
in one hour A  can fill = 1/6 of the tank
B can fill = 1/9 of the tank 
and C can empty = 1/12 of the tank

so, in one hour the total fill up = 1/6 + 1/9 - 1/12
= 7/36 of the tank

∴ the full tank will be filled in 36/7 hours

Bank Math Master.question: ১১) A man, a woman and a boy can do a piece of work in 6, 9 and 18 days respectively. How many boys must assist one man and one woman to do the work in 1 day ?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A man, a woman and a boy can do a piece of work in 6, 9 and 18 days respectively. How many boys must assist one man and one woman to do the work in 1 day ?

Solution: 
(1 man + 1 woman)'s 1 day's work
= 1/6 + 1/9
= 5/18
Remaining work=(1 − 5/18)
=13/18

Work done by 1 boy in 1 day = 1/18

∴Number of boys required= (13×18)/18 boys
=13 boys

Bank Math Master.question: ১২) A pump can fill a tank with water in 2 hours. Because of a leak, it took 7/3 hours to fill the tank. The leak can drain all the water of the tank in:
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A pump can fill a tank with water in 2 hours. Because of a leak, it took 7/3 hours to fill the tank. The leak can drain all the water of the tank in:

Solution:
Let, the leak can drain the full water in X hours
in one hour,
the leak drains 1/X
the pump pores 1/2

so, in one hour the tank fills = 1/2 - 1/X
= (X - 2)/2X

Atq,
2x/(X - 2) = 7/3
6X = 7X - 14
X = 14

So, the leak will drain the whole water in just 14 hours.

Bank Math Master.question: ১৩) 12 men can do a piece of work in 24 days. How many days are needed to complete the work, if 8 men do this work ?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: 12 men can do a piece of work in 24 days. How many days are needed to complete the work, if 8 men do this work ?

Solution: 
12 men can do a piece of work in 24 days
∴ M1=12 and D1=24

Let, 8 men can do this work in D2 days
∴ M2=8

M1 × D1 = M2 × D2
⇒12 × 24 = 8 × D2
⇒D2 = (12 × 24)/8
⇒D2 = 36 days

Bank Math Master.question: ১৪) A tank is filled in 8 hours by three pipes A, B and C. The pipe C is twice as fast as B and B is twice as fast as A. How much time will pipe A alone take to fill the tank?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A tank is filled in 8 hours by three pipes A, B and C. The pipe C is twice as fast as B and B is twice as fast as A. How much time will pipe A alone take to fill the tank?

Solution: 
Let,
C can fill the tank in X hours
∴ B can do it in 2X hours and,
A can do it in 4X hours.

in one hour all the pipes can fill = (1/X + 1/2X + 1/4X)
= 7/4X

ATQ.
4X/7 = 8
X = 56/4
= 14 
∴ time required for A is = 4 × 14 = 56 hours

Bank Math Master.question: ১৫) Rakib can do a certain work in 14 days. After half the work is done Rakib got sick and skip the work for 5 days. After he returns, he started doing the rest of the work in half of his previous efficiency. Total time to finish the work is-
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: Rakib can do a certain work in 14 days. After half the work is done Rakib got sick and skip the work for 5 days. After he returns, he started doing the rest of the work in half of his previous efficiency. Total time to finish the work is- 

Solution: 
half of the work is done in 7 days and the rate of work per day is 1/14
afte the effiency became half, work per day = 1/28
∴ half of the work will take = 28/2 = 14 days

∴ total time to do the work is = 7 + 5 + 14 days
= 26 days

Bank Math Master.question: ১৬) 2 leak A and B can drain a cistern in 10 and 20 hours individually. If both the leaks work together, the time required to drain haft of the cistern's water is-
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: 2 leak A and B can drain a cistern in 10 and 20 hours individually. If both the leaks work together, the time required to drain haft of the cistern's water is-

Solution: 
in one hour 2 leaks can drain = 1/10 + 1/20
= 3/20 of the cistern

so, time to drain the whole cistern is = 20/3 hours
∴ half of the cistern in = 20/6 = 10/3 hours

Bank Math Master.question: ১৭) 5 men or 10 women can do a task in 20 days both. If 5 men and 5 women is assigned for the task, how much time will it take to complete it?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question:  5 men or 10 women can do a task in 20 days both. If 5 men and 5 women is assigned for the task, how much time will it take to complete it?

Solution: 
5 men can do in one day = 1/20

10 women can do in one day = 1/20
∴ 5 women can do in one day = 1/40

so in one day 5 men and 5 women can do = 1/20 + 1/40
= 3/40

∴ time required to do the full task = 40/3 days

Bank Math Master.question: ১৮) Half of a cistern is filled by pipe A in 4 hours whereas drained by pipe B in 5 hours. How much time will it take to fill the cistern if both the pipes are opened?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: Half of a cistern is filled by pipe A in 4 hours whereas drained by pipe B in 5 hours. How much time will it take to fill the cistern if both the pipes are opened?

Solution:
A can fill the cistern in 8 hours
B can drain it in 10 hours

together they can fill = 1/8 - 1/10 
= 1/40

∴ total time to fill the cistern is 40 hours.

Bank Math Master.question: ১৯) 50 workers can build 50 engines working 8 hours a day. How many workers need to be appointed extra to boost the production to double if they work 10 hours a days?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: 50 workers can build 50 engines working 8 hours a day. How many workers need to be appointed extra to boost the production to double if they work 10 hours a days?

Solution:
8 hours to build 50 engines by 50 workers
1 hour to build 1 engine by = (50 × 8)/50 workers
10 hours to build 100 engine by = (8 × 100)/10 workers 
= 80 workers

∴ extra workers = 80 - 50 = 30
